summary: Added GoalConfig.githubPush typing and strict Zod schema, implemented pushRunBranch and createRunPullRequest in git-checkpoint with fail-closed private-repo guard via isRepoPrivate, and added mocked unit tests covering push success, non-private guard skip, PR creation success, and PR creation failure. Verified with pnpm exec vitest run src/goal/git-checkpoint.push.test.ts and pnpm build.
